recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not broaden Request.supportingInfo to CodeableReference without a new FHIR-I decision; resource-specific exceptions such as ServiceRequest should remain separately justified.
issue_request: Resolved - No Change/Not Persuasive FHIR-I issue proposing that the broad Request.supportingInfo pattern element change to CodeableReference to support coded or textual laboratory request context such as OBR-13.
initial_application: No source-changing application was required because the final decision was no-change. Current Request.supportingInfo remains Reference(Any); the ServiceRequest-specific CodeableReference outcome belongs to FHIR-25552 and is already audited separately.
additional_context: FHIR-25554 is part of the same FHIR-25552/FHIR-25553/FHIR-25554 issue family found through the seed comments and OO minutes. FHIR-25553's note/supportingInfo guidance is present, and ServiceRequest's resource-specific divergence is documented separately rather than applied to the broad Request pattern.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current Request pattern source matches the no-change decision and continues to point implementers to the notes-vs-supportingInfo guidance.
